CONSULTATION PAPER
Proposed amendments to the reporting
regime for crypto-asset service providers

1. Introduction
This paper sets out proposed changes to the periodic
reporting regime applicable to crypto-asset service
providers authorised under the Regulation.

The proposals build on feedback received during the
preceding call for evidence and are intended to reduce
duplicate reporting across jurisdictions.

2. Scope of the proposals
The proposals apply to all authorised providers offering
custody, exchange or placement services, and introduce a
single consolidated quarterly return replacing three
existing forms.

3. Next steps
Comments are invited by the closing date set out on the
cover page. A summary of responses will be published
after the consultation closes.
